plan.reason: With 24/100 evaluations used and no recent improvement (stagnation 23), overly greedy exploitation risks sticking in a poor basin. Auto surrogate lets held-out RMSE choose between RBF and quadratic, hedging against an unknown 5-D landscape. Raising exploration to 0.6 and mutation to 0.8 diversifies via the novelty term while current_to_best keeps a directed step toward the incumbent; moderate local_fraction and radius balance local refinement with exploration. Smaller population/generations per cycle preserves the fixed budget for more adaptive surrogate rebuilds.
